text.tspan: Hi Maya, I'm writing to let you know that
the launch review is scheduled for Friday at
2 p.m. The draft is 6 pages long, and two
questions about pricing are still open. It
would be greatly appreciated if you could
add your comments by Thursday at noon. If
that timing doesn't work, please reply with
a time that does. Thanks, Alex
